content.summary: If you have been watching Nitto Denko’s stock, you know the ride has been exciting lately. With a year-to-date climb of 31.0% and an impressive 50.2% return over just the past twelve months, it is reasonable to stop and ask whether now is the time to jump in or cash out. While the past week has seen the share price flatten out, longer-term investors have been well rewarded, with a 115.4% gain over three years and nearly 200% over five years.
